Both shell openings pass bounded rays at three heights; floor support and RELIEF/SKIN return pass. Existing scene and chapter retained; headset comfort is not certified.

Newer native work adds a pink trail, a recorded sidestep and reversible miniature scale, but none constitutes a tracked-headset crossing.
